scenario: A compliance officer at a defense contractor reviews a product technical specification PDF to determine whether the item falls under EAR (Export Administration Regulations) controlled categories. The workflow extracts structured product parameters from the PDF, runs a text-based analysis to produce a technology-sensitivity score for the item description, and generates a formal Export Control Determination Report classifying the product as EAR99, ECCN-controlled, or requiring a license.
info_flow: habib-pdf-to-json extracts product specification text and parameters from the PDF → nlp-toolkit scores the extracted description for text characteristics and emits a sensitivity_score → reporting uses the sensitivity_score to classify the product and generate a formal EAR determination report.
